rules.target: research article on a nanocarrier whose own material contains rare-earth (lanthanide) elements — coordination polymers, nucleotide self-assemblies, rare-earth-doped amorphous calcium phosphate or glasses, rare-earth hydroxide/carbonate/oxide carriers, rare-earth-functionalized nanoparticles — used to load and release a drug; amorphous carriers are rated 高, crystalline ones 中
rules.borderline: rare earths used only for luminescence or contrast while another material carries the drug (e.g. upconversion NaYF4 cores with a mesoporous silica shell), or rare-earth nanomaterials for therapy without drug loading
rules.excluded: reviews and books, rare-earth materials without a biomedical use, drug carriers without rare earths
rules.decided: 2026-10-16: the user chose 'rare earth as the carrier itself, amorphous preferred'; all 12 indexed papers of the collection are seeds or targets
